scripts.build: npm run build:xiyou && npm run build --workspace=@cfgcn/website
scripts.test:rust: node scripts/rust.mjs test -p cfgcn-game-core --locked && node scripts/rust.mjs run -p cfgcn-game-core --example escort --locked && node scripts/rust.mjs run -p cfgcn-game-core --example journey --locked
scripts.check:rust: node scripts/rust.mjs fmt --all -- --check && node scripts/rust.mjs clippy --workspace --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --locked -- -D warnings && npm run test:rust
scripts.check: npm run check:art && npm run check:terrain && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:rust && npm run build
